results.question: 每个班级第一次考核的平均分是多少？按平均分从高到低排。
results.sql:
SELECT sbi.class_id, AVG(sc.score) AS avg_score
FROM ai0720score sc
JOIN student_base_info sbi ON sc.stu_id = sbi.stu_id
WHERE sc.exam_order = 1
AND sc.is_deleted = 0
AND sbi.is_delete = 0
GROUP BY sbi.class_id
ORDER BY avg_score DESC
results.validated_sql: SELECT sbi.class_id, AVG(sc.score) AS avg_score FROM ai0720score AS sc JOIN student_base_info AS sbi ON sc.stu_id = sbi.stu_id WHERE sc.exam_order = 1 AND sc.is_deleted = 0 AND sbi.is_delete = 0 GROUP BY sbi.class_id ORDER BY avg_score DESC LIMIT 50

results.question: 列出两次考核都在 80 分及以上的学生姓名和班级。
results.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT s.stu_name, s.class_id
FROM ai0720score a
JOIN student_base_info s ON a.stu_id = s.stu_id AND s.is_delete = 0
WHERE a.is_deleted = 0
AND a.exam_order IN (1, 2)
AND a.score >= 80
GROUP BY a.stu_id, s.stu_name, s.class_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.exam_order) = 2
results.validated_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.stu_name, s.class_id FROM ai0720score AS a JOIN student_base_info AS s ON a.stu_id = s.stu_id AND s.is_delete = 0 WHERE a.is_deleted = 0 AND a.exam_order IN (1, 2) AND a.score >= 80 GROUP BY a.stu_id, s.stu_name, s.class_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.exam_order) = 2 LIMIT 50

results.question: 不及格超过两次（含两次）的学生有哪些？
results.sql:
SELECT
s.stu_id,
s.stu_name,
COUNT(CASE WHEN sc.score < 60 THEN 1 END) AS fail_count
FROM student_base_info s
JOIN ai0720score sc ON s.stu_id = sc.stu_id
WHERE s.is_delete = 0
AND sc.is_deleted = 0
GROUP BY s.stu_id, s.stu_name
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN sc.score < 60 THEN 1 END) >= 2
results.validated_sql: SELECT s.stu_id, s.stu_name, COUNT(CASE WHEN sc.score < 60 THEN 1 END) AS fail_count FROM student_base_info AS s JOIN ai0720score AS sc ON s.stu_id = sc.stu_id WHERE s.is_delete = 0 AND sc.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY s.stu_id, s.stu_name HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN sc.score < 60 THEN 1 END) >= 2 LIMIT 50

results.question: 我们班第二次考核相对第一次平均分涨了多少？
results.sql:
SELECT
ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN s2.exam_order = 2 THEN s2.score END) -
AVG(CASE WHEN s1.exam_order = 1 THEN s1.score END), 2) AS avg_score_increase
FROM ai0720score s1
JOIN ai0720score s2 ON s1.stu_id = s2.stu_id AND s1.exam_order = 1 AND s2.exam_order = 2
JOIN student_base_info b ON s1.stu_id = b.stu_id AND b.is_delete = 0
WHERE s1.is_deleted = 0 AND s2.is_deleted = 0
results.validated_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN s2.exam_order = 2 THEN s2.score END) - AVG(CASE WHEN s1.exam_order = 1 THEN s1.score END), 2) AS avg_score_increase FROM ai0720score AS s1 JOIN ai0720score AS s2 ON s1.stu_id = s2.stu_id AND s1.exam_order = 1 AND s2.exam_order = 2 JOIN student_base_info AS b ON s1.stu_id = b.stu_id AND b.is_delete = 0 WHERE (s1.is_deleted = 0 AND s2.is_deleted = 0) AND b.class_id IN (1) LIMIT 50
